verdict.rationale: The official getting-started docs list a CLI alongside the SDKs, REST API and Web UI as a first-class way to run a parse job, so an official CLI exists. However, that single mention is the only evidence about it, and nothing shows its scope or how it fits agent workflows. Missing for 10: CLI command reference or installation docs, evidence of coverage beyond Parse (Extract/Classify/Split/Index), agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
